summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine transfer of 957,142 treasury shares to participants of its equity-based incentive plans, pursuant to a Board resolution announced on 2 October 2025. No consideration was paid; shares were transferred without payment to settle existing commitments. Following the transfer, Nokia held 87,626,482 own shares. This is a standard share-based compensation settlement, not a capital return, tender offer, or other special situation. No deal terms, premium, or advisors are involved. What to watch: future routine stake updates in Nokia's 6-K filings.
